resources.string: Lets the on-device agent read the screen and perform taps, swipes, scrolls and text entry in any app, over a private on-device socket. Enable only on your own device; you can turn it off at any time.
Lets the agent inspect the foreground app, screenshots and device facts. Screen content is sent to your configured model provider. Tap, type, launch and shell actions stay blocked.
High risk. The agent can act in other apps without asking for each UI action. Shell and file changes remain separately approval-gated.

The agent will be able to tap, type, submit forms and send messages by controlling other apps without asking for every UI action. These actions can affect real people, accounts and data. Shell and file changes remain separately approval-gated. Enable this only while you are supervising the phone.
These optional permissions expose SMS, contacts and phone state to zerodroid’s local tools. Grant only the capabilities you intend to use. Android will ask for each permission separately.
